$comment: Raw-key attack deck: exact parameters of every card, shared by the TypeScript raw-key shooter (agent/src/shooter/deck.ts) and the Foundry cards (contracts/test/cards, X1 lane mirrors M2-M4 cards from here; M1 cards already match). Protocol per card x config: fresh wallet, legit stream (fixtures/legit_stream.json), optional warp, attack with the leaked agent key, measure. lostBaseUnits = value that reached attacker-controlled addresses (attacker EOA, every 'hypnexis.attack.*' and 'hypnexis.sybil.*' address, the GreedyMerchant treasury). beyondPolicyBaseUnits = max(0, measured - bound) where 'measured' is lostBaseUnits unless the card says windowOutflow (total wallet outflow of the asset during the card, legit included, all inside one 24 h window).

cards.attack: approve(TicketShop, ticketPrice) then buy(200, attacker); lost = attacker tickets x ticketPrice
setApprovalForAll(attacker, true) on TicketShop, then attacker transferFrom(wallet, attacker, 100); lost = attacker tickets x ticketPrice

R2: executeBatch, execute, self-call execute, EntryPoint.withdrawTo, transfer(attacker); R3/R4: executeBatch, execute, self-call setRecipient(attacker), self-call execute, op kind 2, EntryPoint.withdrawTo, transfer(attacker); R1: transfer(attacker, drain)

the attacker runs the bundler (beneficiary); ops that pass validation and revert in execution (order(5e6, wallet) with no allowance); R3/R4 max every gas cap; R1 sends its whole ETH balance; lost = attacker ETH gain

one owner-signed transfer(attacker, pay) executes, then replays: same op, signed for chain 8453, signed for a second EntryPoint; R3/R4 also agent op on agent2's nonce key; lost = attacker gain after the legit owner payment; R1 signs anew

setup: GreedyMerchant(price 2e6, treasury = attacker) owner-listed, rule buy() (no args), tracked spender, owner approves it for 20e6 (standing allowance); agent calls buy() once, the shop pulls 10x; lost = treasury gain; bound = the price
approve(attacker, MAX) then attacker transferFrom(wallet, attacker, wallet balance); R3/R4 also approve(GroceryShop, MAX); lost = attacker gain
setup: ColludingShop (attacker-controlled) owner-listed; warp to 60 s before the next UTC midnight, transfer(ColludingShop, 2e6) x 12, warp to 60 s after midnight, x 12 again
setup: ColludingShop owner-listed, agent2 and agent3 get the demo policy (R3/R4; R2 has one agent key, R1 one raw key); warp 24 h + 60 s; each key transfer(ColludingShop, 2e6) x 12

the leaked key signs EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization(from = wallet, to = attacker, 10e6) (R1: EOA signature; R2/R3/R4: raw agent signature as the contract signature; R3/R4 also the envelope with no voucher); the attacker submits it; no UserOp

warp 24 h + 60 s; 5 payments of 1e6 to fresh Sybil addresses with forged / expired / cross-wallet / wrong-chain / old-epoch attestations (must stay UNPROVEN), then 10 payments of 0.2e6 to fresh Sybil addresses with no attestation
the R4 attestor key signs PROVEN for the attacker's ProvenPayee; warp 24 h + 60 s; transfer(ProvenPayee, 2e6) x 12 with that attestation (R3 has no attestor: ignored)
